n: CMU Robot Coding Fundamentals with LEGO CS and AI
t: A grades 6 to 8 coding course for the LEGO Education Computer Science and AI kit.
steps: Find the course on CS2N and the LEGO Education kit 45522 page.
Buy the LEGO CS and AI 6-8 kit.
Join the teacher training through the CS2N group link.
Check that you have a broadband connection and a USB port.
Complete Getting Started and Remote Control.
Ask what the course will cost after development.
